caption: The drawing is a monochromatic illustration primarily rendered in shades of gray and black on a cream-colored background. The central object is a tall, elegant pitcher or ewer with a wide, slightly pointed spout, a high, curving handle attached to the upper rim, and a rounded body that tapers down to a narrow stem and then flares out at the base, which is rectangular. The pitcher features detailed beaded or dotted decoration along its rim and base. On the lower left side of the drawing, there is an ornate, circular monogram surrounded by a laurel wreath motif. On the lower right side is a small, partial side view of the same pitcher, emphasizing the handle and spout from a different angle. All three elements (the pitcher, monogram, and side view) are enclosed within a simple, thin rectangular border. The artist’s name, “Francis Law Durand,” is written in small letters near the lower right corner.
title: Silver Cream Pitcher
